AI Engineering (Robotics) at ASU · Simulation, Control, and Machine Learning

I am an M.S. AI Engineering (Robotics) student at ASU and a researcher in the RISE Lab. My current focus is a UR5e digital twin: building toward a simulation that can learn from real robot data and support manipulation controllers that transfer to hardware.

Self-Calibrating UR5e Digital Twin

A single-arm UR5e and RG2 digital twin in Isaac Sim, with a long-term goal of using real robot data to improve simulation and transfer manipulation controllers to hardware.

Energy-Aware Quadrotor Control

Collaborative research with John Lok on prescribed-time quadrotor control using an S500-based MuJoCo test bench. Results are simulation-based; hardware flight validation remains future work.

NBA Shot Data Engineering Package

End-to-end NBA shot analytics package combining R data infrastructure with Python modeling workflows. The project supports multi-source ingestion, rerunnable SQLite updates, shot-quality modeling, and player-level archetype analysis.
